# Preparation
## Load Required Libraries 
```{r}
library(tidyverse) # For data manipulation and visualization
library(dplyr) # For data manipulation
library(readxl) # For reading Excel files
library(glmmTMB) # For generalized linear mixed models
library(performance) # For model performance assessment
library(DHARMa)
# optional: library(emmeans)# For residual diagnostics
library(ggplot2) # For data visualization
```

## Load Data
```{r}
tau <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/TAU_CpGs_mit_verhalten_ohne_p61_p59_p34_p29_umstruk.xlsx"))
 
head(tau)
#summary(tau)
#str(tau)
```

## Subset Data and Drop NA

```{r}
# Create a subset of the data with relevant columns and drop rows with NA values
tau_subset <- tau %>%
  select(
    ID,
    standort_aus_andere_quelle,
    Zeit,
    Gruppe,
    Sex,
    Age_start,
    CogTel,
    CpG_position,
    Psycholgical,
    rauchen,
    methylation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),
    standort_aus_andere_quelle = as.factor(standort_aus_andere_quelle),
    Zeit = as.factor(Zeit),
    Gruppe = as.factor(Gruppe),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    CpG_position = as.factor(CpG_position),
    CogTel = as.numeric(CogTel),
    Psycholgical = as.numeric(Psycholgical),
    rauchen = as.factor(rauchen),
    methylation = as.numeric(methylation)
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

str(tau_subset)
```

```{r}
summary(tau_subset$methylation)
range(tau_subset$methylation)
sum(tau_subset$methylation == 1)  # Count how many exact 1s
sum(tau_subset$methylation == 0)  # For reference on zeros
```

Ein einzelner Wert = 1

```{r}
tau_subset$methylation <- tau_subset$methylation[tau_subset$methylation == 1] <- 1 - 1e-9
```


## 

# Model Fitting

```{r}
# model
tau_glmm_1 <- glmmTMB(
  methylation ~ Gruppe * Zeit + Sex + rauchen + Age_start + CogTel + Psycholgical +
    (1 + Zeit | ID) + (1 | CpG_position),            # random intercepts + Zeit slope by ID
  ziformula = ~ Gruppe + Zeit + (1 | CpG_position),  # drivers of exact zeros
  dispformula = ~ 1 + (1 | CpG_position),            # allow CpG-specific dispersion (optional)
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = d,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(tau_glmm_1)

# diagnostics
tau_glmm_1 <- simulateResiduals(fit, n = 1000)
plot(tau_glmm_1)

#(Optional) Marginal means / contrasts for Gruppe × Zeit
# em <- emmeans(tau_glmm_1, ~ Gruppe * Zeit, type = "response")
# pairs(em, by = "Zeit")  # or other contrasts

```


```{r}
tau_glmm_1 <- glmmTMB(
  methylation ~ Gruppe + Zeit + Sex + rauchen + (1|ID),            # random intercepts + Zeit slope by ID
  ziformula = ~ Zeit + (1 | CpG_position),  # drivers of exact zeros
  dispformula = ~ 1 + (1 | CpG_position), 
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = tau_subset,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(tau_glmm_1)

# diagnostics
tau_glmm_1 <- simulateResiduals(fit, n = 1000)
plot(tau_glmm_1)

#(Optional) Marginal means / contrasts for Gruppe × Zeit
# em <- emmeans(tau_glmm_1, ~ Gruppe * Zeit, type = "response")
# pairs(em, by = "Zeit")  # or other contrasts

```


```{r}
library(DHARMa)
tau_glmm_1 <- simulateResiduals(fit, n = 1000)
plot(tau_glmm_1)
testUniformity(tau_glmm_1)
testZeroInflation(tau_glmm_1)   # should NOT suggest extra zeros beyond your ziformula
testDispersion(tau_glmm_1)

```

```{r}
fit_phi <- update(
  fit,
  dispformula = ~ Zeit + Gruppe + (1 | ID) + (1 | CpG_position)
)
library(DHARMa)
sim_phi <- simulateResiduals(fit_phi, n = 2000)
plot(sim_phi); testUniformity(sim_phi); testDispersion(sim_phi); testZeroInflation(sim_phi)
```



```{r}
glmmTMB(
  methylation ~ Gruppe * Zeit + Sex + rauchen + Age_start + CogTel + Psycholgical +
    (1 + Zeit | ID) + (1 | CpG_position),            # random intercepts + optional slope
  ziformula = ~ Gruppe + Zeit + (1 | CpG_position),  # what drives exact zeros
  dispformula = ~ 1 + (1 | CpG_position),            # allow CpG-specific dispersion (optional)
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = d
)

```

```{r}
tau_glmm_CpG_ZeitID <- glmmTMB(
  methylation ~ standort_aus_andere_quelle + Gruppe + Sex + Age_start + CogTel + Zeit + (1|CpG_position) + (1|Zeit:ID),
  ziformula = ~1,
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = tau_subset
)
summary(tau_glmm_CpG_ZeitID)
```

```{r}
tau_glmm_CpG_zeit <- glmmTMB(
  methylation ~ standort_aus_andere_quelle + Gruppe + Sex + Age_start + CogTel + Zeit + (1|CpG_position),
  ziformula = ~1,
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = tau_subset
)
summary(tau_glmm_CpG_zeit)
```


```{r}
tau_glmm_CpG_ID <- glmmTMB(
  methylation ~ standort_aus_andere_quelle + Gruppe + Sex + Age_start + CogTel + Zeit + (1|CpG_position) + (1|ID) + (1|Zeit:Gruppe),
  ziformula = ~Zeit + Gruppe,
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = tau_subset
)
summary(tau_glmm_CpG_ID)


```
